summary.text: BCBXI declared their first innings at 371 for 7, featuring a top score of 135 off 184 balls by Kalam Siddiki Aleen against Kavem Hodge, who took 2 for 34. In response, WI reached 336 for 6, led by Kevin Wickham with 67 off 107 balls as Md Hossain claimed 4 for 55, resulting in a drawn match.
